Our Programs

Our programs are designed to give you peace of mind when your child is not in school. Experienced, caring, and licensed staff ensures your child is safe, engaged, and happy! Every student participates in enrichment activities every day, at no additional charge! Coding, Robotics, Art, Drama, Spanish, Mandarin, Sign Language, Fitness & Sports, and Engineering/Maker Activities keep your child engaged and having fun every day at AlphaBEST! Snacks, homework help, recreation, and student-choice clubs are also provided to every student.

Hello, my name is Area Manager. I became a part of the AlphaBEST team since 2020 as the Site Director for Elizabeth Haddon, a year later I was promoted to Operations Specialist for the South Jersey region, and most recently; I have been promoted to Area Manager. Not only am I a resident of Haddonfield along with my husband and two children, but I have been involved with before and after-school programs and a wrap-around kindergarten program in New Jersey since 2010. It is my pleasure to nurture and care for the children in our program. I look forward to our continuous growth in the New Jersey area.
